units: metres unless noted; per-mille for grades
note: Defaults from the Cincinnati Metro Profiles page (no saved override in its database). 500 ft platforms and the 50 per-mille ceiling are canon; the depth thresholds are editable starting values, not canon. Canon structure sections for the founding Lines 1-6 are the CANON table in profile_analyzer.html.
structures_note: Metro structure heights, cover, crossing separation and river depth are fixed rules (railsim/metro_profile.py METRO_ST, profiles.html): box 1.0 below / 4.6 above rail, twin tube 0.68 / 4.08 (4.76 m OD), double-track bore 3.2 / 5.8 (9.0 m OD); crossings upper below-rail + 0.5 + lower rail-to-top; cover 2.0 m over tubes and bores with top above 140.0 m, one OD at or below, 0.6 m over box roofs; under rivers rail <= bed - 7.5 m.
